candidate.definition_en: An open sore on the body, especially in the stomach.
candidate.explanation_ar: قرحة أو جرح مفتوح ومؤلم، غالباً بيجي في المعدة وبيوجع جداً.

senses.definition_en: An open sore on the body, especially in the stomach.
senses.definition_ar: قرحة أو جرح مفتوح مؤلم في نسيج داخلي أو خارجي من الجسم.
examples: Spicy food can irritate an ulcer.
The doctor said he has a stomach ulcer.
The chronic ulcer required surgical intervention to heal.

candidate.mnemonic: Remember 'ulcer' sounds like 'all sore', which perfectly describes a painful open wound or stomach sore.
